source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Premature broad abnormal QRS-T complexes occur without a preceding P wave or without a related P wave.
QRS duration usually exceeds 120 ms; T polarity is usually opposite to the dominant QRS deflection.
The pause is often fully compensatory; coupling is measured from QRS onset.
Bigeminy alternates sinus and premature beats; trigeminy has one premature beat after every two sinus beats (printed-page 477 terminology).

authored_choices.morphology: Reuses broad QRS and discordant T from VentricularEscapeTables only where the original ordinal modulo 4 equals 3. Reusing morphology does not reuse escape timing or locate the same ectopic focus.
authored_choices.sinusSlots: The final slot of this fixed example emits no atrial electrical/mechanical events; the next sinus P occurs at 3200 ms. No sinus-node reset is inferred, and this does not assert that all PVCs lack independent P waves.

groupedVariants.shared: Coupling is 500 ms and the compensatory pause is 1100 ms. The final slot has no atrial events; morphology/amplitude match the original monomorphic example.

implementation: Normal/PVC morphology is selected by group length 2/3/4 and the final-slot mask. Sinus P/QRS/T are preserved; the original index is group*count+slot.
An independent 3200 ms indexed accessor supplies actual mechanical events to the timeline and pressure. No new atrial event kind is added.
Half-open intervals, exact budgets, original group*4+slot indexing and bounded-lookback recovery; no replay from the epoch.
Twelve-lead and monitor lead II share a source. The QRS summary explicitly verifies sinus slot 0 only.
Both demos load fixed examples and reset previous parameters, supporting direct switching and atomic rejection. Other physiological channels use actual ventricular/respiratory events.
Group length drives event timing, morphology masks, pressure access and recovery. AV conduction ratios are not used to simulate bigeminy/trigeminy.
limitations: Specific durations, amplitudes and one PVC after every three sinus beats are authored parameters, not traced textbook measurements.
The original monomorphic example and fixed bigeminy/trigeminy sequences are implemented. Couplets, polymorphic/multifocal beats, interpolated beats and R-on-T are unimplemented.
No automatic ectopic-focus, retrograde-conduction, fusion, concealed-conduction, refractory or sinus-node mechanism.
Mechanical events occur early without modeling beatwise filling/stroke volume, PVC pulse deficit or post-extrasystolic potentiation. Ventricular mechanics can be explicitly disabled.
VT/SVT and other ECG, respiratory, perfusion and artifact work remain open; dynamic UI rulers are deferred.
Windows visual behavior is not yet manually verified.
